### The Scroll and the Watchman
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/scroll-and-watchman
Passage: Ezekiel 3:2-3
Points:
- God commanded Ezekiel to consume a scroll filled with lamentation and covenant curses.
- Despite its somber message of judgment, the Word tasted sweet as honey to the prophet.
- Hearing God's righteous verdict on sin prepares hearts to receive the gospel of grace.
- Ezekiel was sent to his own people, who resisted God because of hard hearts rather than lack of understanding.
- Servants of God must faithfully declare the truth regardless of how listeners respond.

### Bible Pathway - September 1
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-sept-1-2012.html
Passage: Ezekiel 3:10-11
Points:
- God instructed Ezekiel to hear and take His words deeply into his heart before going out to speak.
- Feeding on the Word strengthened the prophet to withstand intense opposition from a rebellious audience.
- God equips those He commissions, supplying whatever is required to carry out His work.
- Believers are responsible for faithfully delivering the message to others whether people choose to listen or not.
